name: Crimson Shackles
descriptionTemplate: Lose 10% of current HP, randomly deal [Damage:Arg1] DMG 2 times and inflict {Bleed} equal to 50% DMG dealt. After playing 3 times, transform into {Bloodthirsty Flail}.
lore:
Atropos cuts the black thread, severing the fate of the Tylos.
The warrior who wielded shackles as weapons,
and once so valiant, finally falls before countless spears.
